tagline: Personal shopper for your AI agent: plain-language rules + visual marketplace so non-technical users safely let an agent shop.
description: VoiceLeash bridges non-technical consumers and autonomous AI agents. Users speak or type spending rules in plain English. The agent browses a visual marketplace of digital capabilities (data feeds, weather APIs, market intelligence) and proposes purchases. Low-cost items are auto-approved under the leash; high-value purchases require a 1-tap human signature. The agent never receives a full-access key, only a mathematically restricted NEAR Function-Call key.
demo_steps: 1. Connect NEAR testnet wallet (Meteor Wallet or direct RPC lookup)
2. Deposit daily 1.0 NEAR budget on-chain -> Enables autonomous shopping with ZERO wallet pop-ups
3. Set spending rules in plain language (e.g., 'Spend up to 1 NEAR daily, ask above 0.25')
4. Type a goal or run 'Weather Radar' (0.15 NEAR) -> Autonomous purchase succeeds with 0 wallet pop-ups
5. Buy a high-cost capability (e.g. Market Summary 0.5 NEAR) -> Intercepted for 1-tap human approval
6. Inspect deliverables in Audit Trail and 1-click export to JSON / CSV
7. Click 'Reclaim Test Funds' in Leash Rules -> Escrow Vault refunds 100% of test funds back to your wallet
ai_disclosure: Frontend UI components and initial boilerplate were assisted with AI coding tools; custom architecture, NEAR Function-Call key enforcement logic, and plain-language regex parsing engine were designed and verified for the hackathon.
